controls: Click a tube or press keys 1-9 to select source and destination
Escape cancels the visual-only pour cue

semantic_event_mapping.POUR: native POUR records one accepted maximal transfer from a source tube to a destination tube

assumptions: Pointer and number-key selection both dispatch native numeric source/destination selection.
Pour transfers the maximal contiguous top run that fits.
Completed tubes are empty or full and single-color.
Liquid state updates atomically; a separate visual-only cue can be canceled with Escape without changing game state.
frame(ms) and ordinary RAF advance the same cue timer.
Source and usage budgets are unverified.
invalid_index_behavior: Numeric selection and explicit source/destination indices are zero-based integers; invalid values reject without mutation or events.
